title: Install, set up, then choose your view
subtitle: No code needed - follow one clear route
captionText: Follow the current GoNuts interface. Simple and Advanced use the same saved settings. Pause at any step.

title: 1. Prepare Fabric
subtitle: Match the versions before installing
captionText: Use Minecraft Java Edition 26.2, Fabric Loader, the matching Fabric API mod, and Java 25. The written guide links the official Fabric instructions. Use the Fabric setup for your own launcher.

title: 2. Download GoNuts
subtitle: Use the public Download button
captionText: Open gonuts.at and choose Download for Minecraft 26.2. Save the GoNuts jar without extracting it. Normal keyless setup does not need a manual API key.

title: 3. Put both mods in the right folder
subtitle: Close Minecraft before changing mods
bullets: GoNuts + Fabric API go in mods
captionText: Close Minecraft. Open the game folder for the installation you actually launch. Put GoNuts and the matching Fabric API jar in its mods folder. Create mods if missing. Keep only one GoNuts jar. Updating does not require deleting your configuration.

title: 4. Join DonutSMP, then press B
subtitle: Open the mod after joining the server
captionText: Launch your Fabric installation and join DonutSMP. Enable the sidebar scoreboard in the server settings so GoNuts can read your balance. Press B. Check Minecraft Controls if you changed that key binding.

title: 5. Open Help & setup
subtitle: Settings is the reliable route back to setup
captionText: New installs open Start here. To return later, press B, choose Settings, then Help and setup. Choose Set up trading. Do not search for a separate START HERE navigation tab.

title: 6. Choose your spending limits
subtitle: Step 1 of the setup form
captionText: Enter maximum per trade and maximum session spend. Choose your own amounts; these screenshot values are examples, not recommendations. Swarm is optional. Review and continue opens the second step. It does not start trading.

title: 7. Review protections if you use them
subtitle: Return to setup after reviewing
captionText: Review protections opens Evasion. Read its options and review Staff Watch separately if you use it. Return to setup afterward. Swarm linking and Discord are optional connections. Opening a guide does not start or resume trading.

title: 8. Review, then Start trading
subtitle: Read the amounts and any blocker
captionText: On Review and Start, check your limits and readiness. This offline demonstration has not joined a server, so Start is disabled. On your client, read the actual blocker. Choose Start trading only when ready. Existing recovery and trade checks still apply.

title: 9. Find trading status
subtitle: You do not need to search through every setting
bullets: End is the default emergency stop
captionText: Open Trading, then Trade for status and controls. A connected client is not necessarily trading. Read the actual reason before taking action. End is the default emergency stop.

title: 10. Hidden menus or hotbar?
subtitle: Use the display shortcut instead of resetting everything
captionText: Open Settings, Help and setup, then Show menus plus hotbar. Only those two display options change. This is not a full settings or trading-history reset.

title: 11. Simple settings preserve your choices
subtitle: Core controls without the wall of settings
captionText: Simple groups order management, trading style, action pace and order batch ceiling. Custom means existing values stay as they are. Choosing an option opens an exact change preview. Only Apply saves those changes.

title: 12. Advanced settings and warnings
subtitle: All individual controls, grouped by task
captionText: Advanced keeps every individual setting. Choose a category or search. Warnings explain interactions such as disabled bidding or sizing limits. A batch ceiling is a maximum, not a promised order size or profit. Switching views changes nothing.
